This notebook will be following analysis defined in (Ishigaki et al., 2022) and implemented [here](https://github.com/immunogenomics/cdr3-QTL).

Executing slurm parallelized CDR3-QTL analysis.

```{r}
cdr3_phenotypes <- c(
  "cdr3_p1_strat_filtered_cv1k", "cdr3_p1_unstrat_filtered_cv1k", 
  "cdr3_p2_strat_filtered_cv1k", "cdr3_p2_unstrat_filtered_cv1k")
# slurm batchtools parallelzed alternative
batch_params <- expand.grid(
    "phenotype_type" = cdr3_phenotypes, 
    "hsite" = unique(full_aa_hla_sites$hla_site),
    "cdr3_pos" = imgt_pos_testable,
    "cdr3length" = c(12:18)
    ) %>% 
    as.data.frame() %>%
    mutate(
        results_dir = glue("{wkdir}/data/interim/cdr3_qtl/results/{phenotype_type}"),
        cdr3length = as.character(cdr3length),
        wkdir = wkdir,
        cdr3length = case_when(
            grepl("_unstrat_", phenotype_type) ~ NA_character_,
            TRUE ~ cdr3length
        )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct() %>% 
    mutate_all(as.character) %>% 
    glimpse()

# configure registry ----
breg <- breg_setup(cluster_name = "CDR3_QTL", 
    log_dir = glue("{wkdir}/.cluster_runs/"),
    template_path = glue("{wkdir}/batchtools_templates/batchtools.slurm.tmpl")
    )

# Submit Jobs ----
jobs <- batchMap(
  fun = run_qtl_stats,
  args = batch_params,
  reg = breg
)
nrow(batch_params)

jobs[, chunk := chunk(job.id, chunk.size = 40)]
print(jobs[, .N, by = chunk])

# can probably do two per minute so x jobs / 2 = minutes
submitJobs(jobs,
  resources = list(
    walltime = "2:00:00",
    memory = "10GB",
    ncpus = 2,
    max.concurrent.jobs = 9999
  )
)

```

## Running serially (not parallel)

If you want to run serially (not parallel) you can use the following code.

```{r}
for (pheno in cdr3_phenotypes) {
  for (hsite in unique(full_aa_hla_sites$hla_site)) {
    for (cdr3_pos in imgt_pos_testable) {
      if (grepl("_unstrat_", pheno)) {
        message("NO CDR3 length filtering")
        run_qtl_stats(
          results_dir = glue("{wkdir}/data/interim/cdr3_qtl/results/{pheno}"), 
          phenotype_type = pheno,
          hsite = hsite,
          cdr3_pos = cdr3_pos,
          cdr3length = NULL
        )
      } else {
        for (cdr3length in c(12:18)) {
          message(glue("Processing {pheno} {hsite} {cdr3_pos} {cdr3length}..."))
          run_qtl_stats(
            results_dir = glue("{wkdir}/data/interim/cdr3_qtl/results/{pheno}"), 
            phenotype_type = pheno,
            hsite = hsite,
            cdr3_pos = cdr3_pos,
            cdr3length = cdr3length
          )
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

```


This section walks through what the script and slurm jobs are doing in more detail.

Function to normalize AA amino acid frequency into a standard normal distribution (INT-transform). This process will occur for each IMGT position x HLA-AA site combination.

```{r}
# first prepping the site data into a wide format
gdata <- full_aa_hla_sites %>% 
  dplyr::filter(hla_site == "DRB1_13") %>% 
  dplyr::filter(nchar(HLA_AA_site) == 1) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(fdigit, aatype)) %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(participant_id, HLA_AA_site) %>% 
  dplyr::summarize(allele_dosage = sum(allele_dosage)) %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = HLA_AA_site, values_from = allele_dosage) %>%
  dplyr::rename_at(vars(-participant_id), ~ paste0(., "_allele")) %>% 
  glimpse()
gdata

pdata <- cdr3_p1_strat_filtered_cv1k %>% 
  dplyr::filter(imgt_pos == "P109") %>% 
  dplyr::filter(cdr3len == 13) %>% 
  dplyr::select(participant_id, AA = aa, ratio) %>% 
  glimpse()
pdata

# visualzing the distribution of AA frequencies
pdata %>% ggplot(aes(x=ratio,fill=AA))+
    geom_histogram(bins = 30)+
    facet_wrap(~AA)+
    theme_bw()+
    theme(legend.position = "none")+
    labs(title="Distribution of amino acid frequencies (pre-transform, same scale)")

# Same data but relaxed scale 
pdata %>% ggplot(aes(x=ratio,fill=AA))+
    geom_histogram(bins = 30)+
    facet_wrap(~AA,scale="free_x")+
    theme_bw()+
    theme(legend.position = "none")+
    labs(title="Distribution of amino acid frequencies (pre-transform, same scale)")


# INT-transform (inverse normal transformation)
pall <- data.frame()
pnamelist <- unique(pdata$AA)
for( ptarget in pnamelist){
    pdata2 <- subset(pdata, AA==ptarget)
    pdata2 <- pdata2[,c("participant_id", "ratio")]
    x <- pdata2$ratio
    pdata2$normrate <- qnorm( (rank(x, na.last="keep") - 0.5) / sum(!is.na(x)) ) #inverse normal normalization
    
    df <- pdata2[,c("participant_id","normrate")]
    df$AA <- ptarget
    pall <- rbind(pall,df)
}
pall

# options(repr.plot.width=12, repr.plot.height=6)
pall %>% ggplot(aes(x=normrate,fill=AA))+
    geom_histogram(bins = 30)+
    facet_wrap(~AA)+
    theme_bw()+
    theme(legend.position = "none")+
    labs(title="Distribution of amino acid frequencies (pre-transform, same scale)")
pall

# Function to estimate a p-value for model fit using Pillai's trace

#full model (exclude S_allele, the most frequent allele, as the reference allele)
mod1 <- lm( 
    cbind(A,D,E,F,G,H,I,K,L,M,N,P,Q,R,S,T,V,W,Y) ~
        F_allele + G_allele + H_allele + R_allele + Y_allele +
        MHC_all_PC1+MHC_all_PC2+MHC_all_PC3, 
    data = M)

#null model
mod0 <- lm( 
    cbind(A,D,E,F,G,H,I,K,L,M,N,P,Q,R,S,T,V,W,Y) ~
        MHC_all_PC1+MHC_all_PC2+MHC_all_PC3, 
    data = M)

summary(mod1)
summary(mod0)

test <- anova(mod1, mod0)
test

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variance explained using MVLM
library(MVLM)
#full model
mod1 <- mvlm( 
    cbind(A,D,E,F,G,H,I,K,L,M,N,P,Q,R,S,T,V,W,Y) ~
        F_allele + G_allele + H_allele + R_allele + Y_allele +
        MHC_all_PC1+MHC_all_PC2+MHC_all_PC3, 
    data = M)

summary(mod1)
var_exp_full <- mod1$pseudo.rsq["Omnibus Effect",1]
var_exp_full

#null model
mod0 <- mvlm( 
    cbind(A,D,E,F,G,H,I,K,L,M,N,P,Q,R,S,T,V,W,Y) ~
        MHC_all_PC1+MHC_all_PC2+MHC_all_PC3, 
    data = M)

var_exp_null <- mod0$pseudo.rsq["Omnibus Effect",1]
var_exp_null

corrected_var_exp <- var_exp_full - var_exp_null
corrected_var_exp

lm_results_dir <- glue("{wkdir}/data/interim/cdr3_qtl/lm_results")
dir.create(lm_results_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

run_lm_site_pos_pair <- function(pdata, gdata, covar_df, hla_aa_allele, cdr3_aa) {
  require(glue)
  require(dplyr)
  
  # filtering the cdr3_aa data
  pdata2 <- subset(pdata, AA==cdr3_aa) %>% 
    dplyr::select(participant_id, normrate) %>% 
    glimpse()
  
  # preparing genotype data
  gdata2 <- gdata %>% dplyr::select(participant_id, {{hla_aa_allele}})
  
  # Joining data
  M_data <- pdata2 %>% 
    dplyr::left_join(gdata2, by = "participant_id") %>% 
    dplyr::left_join(covar_df, by = "participant_id")

  model_formula <- as.formula(
      glue("normrate ~ {hla_aa_allele} + MHC_all_PC1+MHC_all_PC2+MHC_all_PC3")
      )
  mod <- lm(model_formula, data = M_data)
  return(mod)
}
```

Aggregating the results of the MANOVA and MVLM analysis.

```{r}
manova_paths <- list.files(
  glue("{wkdir}/data/interim/cdr3_qtl/results"),
  recursive = TRUE,
  pattern = "mlm_mvlm_",
  full.names = TRUE
)
length(manova_paths)


pull_manova_results <- function(path) {
  require(glue)
  require(dplyr)
  require(strex)
  
  descriptor <- basename(path) %>% gsub("mlm_mvlm_", "", .)
  pheno <- str_before_first(descriptor, "__")
  hsite <- descriptor %>% str_after_first("HLAsites-") %>% str_before_first("__")
  cdr3_pos <- descriptor %>% str_after_first("CDR3pos-") %>% str_before_first("__")
  cdr3_len <- descriptor %>% str_after_first("CDR3len-") %>% str_before_first(".rds")

  res <- readRDS(path)
  pillai_res <- res$manova_res %>% broom::tidy()
  
  manova_df <- pillai_res[2,] %>% 
    mutate(full_model = pillai_res$term[1]) %>% 
    mutate(phenotype_type = pheno, hsite = hsite, 
      cdr3_pos = cdr3_pos, cdr3_len = cdr3_len,
      mnibus_explained_variance = res$mvlm_corrected_var_exp
      )
  return(manova_df)
}

future::plan("multisession", workers = 8)
manova_df <- manova_paths %>% 
  purrr::set_names(basename(.)) %>% 
  furrr::future_map(pull_manova_results) %>% 
  bind_rows(.id = "path") %>% 
  glimpse()

manova_df %<>% 
  separate(hsite, into = c("hla_allele", "hla_site"), sep = "_", remove = FALSE) %>% 
  mutate(hla_site = as.numeric(hla_site)) %>% 
    mutate(hla_allele = factor(hla_allele, 
      levels = c("A", "B", "C", "DRB1", "DQA1", "DQB1", "DPA1", "DPB1"))) %>% 
  glimpse()

saveRDS(manova_df, glue("{wkdir}/data/interim/cdr3_qtl/results/compiled/manova_df_{Sys.Date()}.rds"))

```

```{r}
      show.legend = FALSE,
      parse = TRUE # pretty math notation
    ) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
    facet_wrap(~hla_allele, scales = "free") +
    labs(title = "Correlation between variance explained (MVLM) by Ishigaki et al. (2022) and this study \n CDR3 length stratified & Germline Removed") +
    # coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
    labs(x = "Ishigaki et al. (2022) Variance Explained", 
      y = "This Study Variance Explained") +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

ggsave(
  glue("{wkdir}/figures/CDR3-qtl/raychaudhuri_vs_amppd__explained_variance_{Sys.Date()}.png"),
  p_var_explained_cor,
  width = 10, height = 10
)
```
